    Gel Viewer

    Lane Intensity

    Load a gel image to inspect a lane profile.

    Manual Steps

    1. 1. Click left gel border
    2. 2. Click right gel border
    3. 3. Click lane dividers
    4. 4. Click ladder lane
    5. 5. Click ladder band (uses MW input) or right-click to type MW
    6. 6. Click top line of target band
    7. 7. Click bottom line of target band
    8. 8. Review per-cell intensities
    9. 9. (Optional) Click bands to add
